data.long_description:
Discover elevated waterfront living with this 3-bedroom apartment in Dubai Creek Residences, North Tower, Dubai Creek Harbour. Set within Emaar’s flagship Creek Island community, the residence offers panoramic views of Dubai Creek, Downtown skyline, and lush landscaped promenades.

 Featuring expansive living spaces, floor-to-ceiling windows, and premium modern finishes, the apartment is designed for both comfort and sophistication. Residents benefit from exceptional amenities including an infinity pool, fully equipped gym, children’s play areas, landscaped leisure decks, and direct access to the Creek Marina with its array of dining and retail options. Ideally located near Dubai Festival City,

Downtown Dubai, and Dubai International Airport, the North Tower combines waterfront tranquility with city connectivity, making it a perfect choice for families and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai’s most desirable master-planned communities.
